# Murmur audit and improvement plan

## Summary

Redesign the app around **Dictate, History, and Settings**, preserve the familiar keyboard layout, and prioritize responsive on-device dictation.

The current feature set is strong: local/cloud recognition, vocabulary, snippets, formatting, saved recordings, transcript editing, keyboard review, and Shortcuts. The main opportunities are reliability, clearer model status, and a more focused capture workflow.

**Verification:** The existing 18 text-processing tests passed. Keyboard freezes remain unconfirmed at runtime; no simulators were available through XcodeBuildMCP, and existing screenshots predate parts of the current UI.

## Audit findings

| Priority | Finding | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Word-boundary correction and delayed suggestions run synchronous spell-checking on the main thread. [Keyboard controller](/Users/dehydratedflask/Documents/Projects/Murmur/Murmur-Keyboard/Sources/MurmurKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift:730) | Strong candidate for brief fast-typing stalls; requires device profiling. |
| P1 | Key feedback invokes audio clicks before text insertion when enabled. | Another possible stall source, particularly around dictation audio sessions. |
| P1 | Changing Tiny/Base saves the selection without replacing the loaded model; engine changes can overlap earlier loads. [Transcription service](/Users/dehydratedflask/Documents/Projects/Murmur/Murmur-Keyboard/Sources/Murmur/TranscriptionService.swift:22) | Displayed selection and actual recognizer can disagree; stale loads can publish readiness. |
| P2 | Recording waits for model readiness, while cached loading can still display “Downloading.” [Capture workflow](/Users/dehydratedflask/Documents/Projects/Murmur/Murmur-Keyboard/Sources/Murmur/ContentView.swift:1236) | Unnecessary capture delay and confusing feedback. |
| P2 | Capture, history, recovery, setup, and model status share one large screen/controller. | Important actions compete visually, and lifecycle behavior is difficult to test independently. |

## Implementation changes

### Keyboard responsiveness

- Instrument touch delivery, feedback, correction, proxy calls, and view updates with content-free timing markers before changing behavior.
- Keep the UIKit key views and existing layout. Correct stale-touch recovery and track accent retraction per press so overlapping fingers cannot retract another key’s text.
- Remove synchronous general spell-checking from interactive typing. Preserve deterministic typo fixes, prepared candidates, and single-delete correction undo. When no correction is ready, insert immediately and leave the word unchanged.
- Generate suggestions from bounded, prepared vocabulary data; invalidate results when the word, cursor, or field changes.
- Keep UIKit objects on their required actor. Apple explicitly marks `UITextChecker` as main-actor bound. [Apple documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/uitextchecker)
- Remove audio clicks from key presses, retain optional haptics, and cache feedback preferences instead of reading shared defaults per touch.
- Reuse one context snapshot per text-change pass and avoid redundant key-style updates.

### Model loading and capture

- Introduce one runtime owner that serializes loading, recognition, and unloading. Join duplicate requests; reject stale completions using model identity and request generation.
- Separate selected model, active model, cached files, and readiness. Apply selection changes automatically when idle; defer them during capture or recognition.
- Show truthful stages: **Download, Prepare, Load, Ready, Failed**. Report download progress where supported and actual cached storage usage. WhisperKit’s pinned version supports explicit download progress and separate preparation/loading operations. [WhisperKit source](https://github.com/argmaxinc/WhisperKit/blob/v0.17.0/Sources/WhisperKit/Core/WhisperKit.swift)
- Start durable audio capture after microphone permission and foreground activation, while model preparation continues.
- After Stop, wait cancellably for readiness. On preparation failure, cancellation, or background expiration, retain the recording with a clear retry action.
- Give final recognition priority over preview. Serialize recognizer access and discard stale preview output.
- Release idle audio resources after capture; use bounded background execution for finalization, preserving recovery data if execution expires.

### App redesign and workflow

- **Dictate:** readiness summary, prominent Record control, language/style controls, elapsed time, provisional text, Pause/Resume, Finish, and Keep for Later.
- **History:** searchable transcripts and a distinct Saved Recordings section; preserve editing, original/polished versions, corrections, export, and retry.
- **Settings:** grouped Dictation, Models, Keyboard, Vocabulary & Snippets, Privacy & Storage, and Appearance.
- Retain Murmur’s violet accent with native typography, semantic surfaces, accessible labels, Dynamic Type, and Reduce Motion support.
- Replace generic onboarding slides with actionable microphone, offline-model, and keyboard setup steps. Request permissions when their purpose is visible.
- Keep errors visible until resolved or dismissed; provide a specific recovery action.
- Extract capture coordination from view state so tabs, sheets, Shortcuts, and keyboard handoffs share one session lifecycle.
- Preserve foreground microphone handoff, session matching, and review-before-insertion preferences.

## Validation and acceptance

- Add focused tests for rapid typing, overlapping touches, accents, correction undo, stale suggestions, and field changes.
- Test concurrent loads, rapid engine/model switching, unload during loading, offline cached startup, download failure, memory pressure, and preview/final serialization.
- Test capture before readiness, interruptions, pause/resume, cancellation, recovery, and matching-session insertion without duplicates.
- Build all three targets and rerun the text-processing suite.
- On the physical **iPhone Air**, profile rapid typing in Notes, Messages, Safari, and another affected app, with feedback and dictation states varied.
- Acceptance: no dropped delivered key touches; target extension-side input latency below 50 ms at p95 and 100 ms at p99. Confirm improvements against the original trace.
- Verify redesigned screens in light/dark appearance, landscape, large text, VoiceOver, and Reduce Motion.

## Defaults and compatibility

- Preserve existing history, recordings, vocabulary, snippets, provider settings, and selected engine.
- Default new installations to Whisper Tiny, optional cloud disabled, and preview disabled.
- Accept fewer automatic spelling guesses to protect typing responsiveness.
- Keep iOS 17 compatibility and current dependencies; add no recognition engine.
- Implement in order: timing baseline and keyboard fixes, model/capture coordination, then app redesign. Require physical-device verification before declaring the freeze resolved.
